bodyHtml:
TP-18 Thermal Expansion Tank

18-Liter (4.5 Gallon) Tank for Hot Water Systems & Water Heaters | Aquasky THERMAL-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

TP-18 is designed specifically to absorb expanded water in closed, hot water systems, protecting water heating systems from excessive pressure and potentially hazardous conditions.

 

TP-18 has a total volume of 18 liters (4.5 gallons). The tank is designed to safely maintain water pressure levels with a maximum operating pressure of 10 bar (150 psi) and a maximum operating temperature of 90 °C (194 °F). 

 

It is factory pre-charged with nitrogen to 3.5 bar (50 psi) for highly stable and safe system performance. With a diameter of 28.0 cm (11.0 inches) and a height of 37.9 cm (14.9 inches), this mid-sized tank provides increased shock absorption and expansion capacity while remaining highly adaptable for residential water heaters and plumbing systems.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The TP-18 is an 18-liter (4.5-gallon) thermal expansion tank engineered specifically for residential closed-loop hot water systems. It serves as a high-capacity safety buffer, absorbing thermal expansion to stabilize system pressure and protect your water heater from excessive stress and relief valve discharges.

Key technical advantages include an FDA-grade polypropylene liner and a heavy-duty butyl diaphragm with an exceptional 400% elongation property. This internal architecture ensures water never contacts the carbon steel shell, maintaining a contaminant-free environment and superior resilience during constant expansion cycles.

Built for superior reliability, the TP-18 features a stainless steel connection with patented Leak Safe technology and a Triple Grade Almond (RAL 1015) epoxy finish. This unit delivers a maintenance-free performance that ensures the longevity of your system and your absolute peace of mind.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • Triple Grade Almond (RAL1015) paint offers high oxidation protection and a durable finish.
  • Stainless-steel connection ensures secure, lead-free plumbing installation.
  • Heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm withstands high temperatures and frequent expansions.
  • Internal FDA-grade polypropylene liner prevents hot water from contacting the metallic shell.
  • Factory pre-charged to 50 PSI with nitrogen for reliable shock absorption and stable pressure.
  • Cold-rolled carbon steel shell provides a rugged, long-lasting build.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the THERMAL-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

In closed hot water systems, thermal expansion occurs naturally as domestic water is heated. The TP-18 works in conjunction with a backflow preventer or check valve to safely absorb this expanded water. It stores the expanded water securely between the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm and the polypropylene liner, while the nitrogen-filled air chamber compresses to accommodate the volume change. By controlling this excessive pressure, it safely maintains water pressure levels and avoids relief valve discharge.

Key benefits

  • Absorbs excess water during heating to prevent relief valve discharge.
  • Protects water heaters and plumbing from high pressure/leaks.
  • Provides a safe, stable system for residential hot water.
  • High-grade internal liner isolates water from metals, preventing tank corrosion.

Typical Applications

  • Closed-loop domestic hot water systems
  • Residential water heating setups
  • Plumbing systems requiring a backflow preventer or check valve

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : How does the TP-18 internal diaphragm withstand high hot-water pressure without tearing?

The TP-18 utilizes a heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm engineered with a massive 400% elongation physical property, allowing it to safely stretch and absorb expanded water volume without tearing.
 

Q2 : Does the exterior paint on TP-18 match the standard of home water heaters?

Yes, the cold-rolled carbon steel shell is coated in a highly durable Triple Grade Almond (RAL 1015) paint, which provides excellent rust resistance while blending cleanly with most standard home utility systems.

Q3 : How heavy is the 4.5-gallon TP-18 to lift and install?

 It is very lightweight, with an empty net weight of just 7.5 lbs (3.4 kg)
